title: ShipHullsResponse
description: Response shape for GET /model/ships/hulls — full ship-hull catalog.

slug.description: Stable machine identifier (lower-snake: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$); safe for URLs, filenames, and asset lookups. Engine-emitted from a fixed catalog and validated by the ship-hulls contract test, so the constraint is documented here rather than enforced as a generated newtype (see docs/adr/0003 on weighing pattern constraints against type churn).

name.description: Display name as shown in the original game (e.g. 'Battle Cruiser', 'B-17 Bomber').

requirement.description: Trait gating, or null when available to all races.

fuel-regen-per-year.description: Hull-intrinsic fuel regenerated per year. Present only on Fuel Transport hulls.

fuel-regen-percent.description: Additional fuel regeneration as percent of current fuel. Present only on Fuel Transport hulls.

hull-category.description: Grouping used by the Ship Designer hull picker.

hull-requirement.description: Trait gate restricting which races may build a hull. 'AR' = Alternate Reality PRT only. 'ARM' = Advanced Remote Mining LRT only. 'MT' = available only after a Mystery Trader exchange. See the owning property for the null (available-to-all) case.

max-count.description: Maximum parts this slot can hold.

slot-position.description: Grid coordinates of the slot in the Ship Designer layout, matching the original game. The unit is half a slot box; the origin is the top-left of the hull's slot cluster.
